collision.mesh_storage: inline vertices in board XML, centered individually for numerical conditioning
collision.method: source horizontal sections, constrained earcut triangulation and adjacent convex merging; extruded convex prisms plus solid bottom slab
collision.nonverticality_note: Submicron source cosmetic engraving inconsistencies are projected vertically; functional profiles are source-derived

detailed.mesh_storage: inline vertices in board XML, centered individually for numerical conditioning
detailed.method: source horizontal sections, constrained earcut triangulation and adjacent convex merging; extruded convex prisms plus solid bottom slab
detailed.nonverticality_note: Submicron source cosmetic engraving inconsistencies are projected vertically; functional profiles are source-derived

functional.difference_from_detailed: Fills only cosmetic engraving recesses at z=0.023..0.025 m; exact functional hole profiles, blind floors, full height and outer footprint are unchanged; original detailed source visual retained
functional.mesh_storage: inline vertices in board XML, centered individually for numerical conditioning
functional.method: same source-derived middle convex partition extruded through full hole depth plus unchanged solid bottom slab
functional.nonverticality_note: Submicron source cosmetic engraving inconsistencies are projected vertically; functional profiles are source-derived

board.scale_calibration: Source XY extent 32 x 25 units matched to user-specified 0.32 x 0.25 m; uniform 0.01 m/unit, consistent with centimetres, not millimetres

physical_assumptions.board: fixed body; no dynamic mass needed
physical_assumptions.inertia: exact uniform extrusion of source cross section; explicit full inertia at volume centroid
physical_assumptions.precision: geometry describes supplied float32 STL, not measured manufacturing tolerances
physical_assumptions.solver_caveat: MuJoCo clamps solref time constant to at least twice the simulation timestep; friction and stiffness are simulation assumptions, not measured force calibration

size_semantics: IDs 0..3 are source hole rows top-to-bottom, tight-to-loose clearance; all four use the same source peg. They are not peg scale factors.
units: metres, kilograms, radians; quaternion order wxyz
